title: Update on Cyber Security Agency's Investigations into Computer Security Initiative Consultancy
what_it_is: Update on Cyber Security Agency's Investigations into Computer Security Initiative Consultancy

sections.label: US list and COSEINC review
sections.summary: US persons need a licence to export regulated items to COSEINC; CSA found no breach of Singapore cybersecurity laws.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The effect of being placed on this List means that US persons intending to export, re-export or transfer items that the US regulates to COSEINC must first obtain a licence to do so from the US Government.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Arising from this, the Cyber Security Agency (CSA) looked into COSEINC.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We can share that, in this regard, it is one of many vendors to have provided training services to the Government and the contractual terms were standard.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: CSA also found no evidence that COSEINC had breached cybersecurity laws in Singapore.
